APPROVE
Moving the `Create` and `Apply` branches into helpers removes the nested conditionals, the early exit and the lambda nesting from `BuildPlan`, which should bring it well under 15; `return` in `AddApplier` acts exactly like the old `continue` because it was the last statement in the loop; and the helper signatures should compile, provided the dictionary types and a `System.Reflection` using match the parts of the file the diff doesn't show, which I couldn't check because the source isn't in this environment.
